title: Irrational Numbers and the Real Line
summary: Numbers like √2 and π that can't be written as fractions, the square-root spiral, and the real number line.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Manjari (2026): The World of Numbers

objectives: I can define irrational and real numbers.
I can explain a proof that √2 is irrational.
I can locate √n on the number line.
misconceptions: Irrational numbers can't be placed on the number line.
